episodes.name: Olympics-Themed Episode
episodes.overview: In this special 30-minute Olympic episode, the “blind auditions” are held in front of the celebrity panel of musician coaches, including Miley Cyrus, Alicia Keys, Adam Levine, and Blake Shelton, who each pick vocalists for their individual teams. The strongest vocalists from across the country compete to be selected by one of the coaches and fight for a chance to win the title of being named “The Voice.”

episodes.name: The Voice: 30th Season Celebration
episodes.overview: Host Carson Daly sits down with iconic coaches - from Blake Shelton, Adam Levine and CeeLo Green to Kelly Clarkson and Gwen Stefani, plus new coaches Queen Latifah and Riley Green - to look back at the show’s evolution and tease the new season.
